arxiv-2012-12565.title: Banach space representations of Drinfeld-Jimbo algebras and their complex-analytic forms Thanks: This work was supported by the RFBR grant no. 19-01-00447.
arxiv-2012-12565.creator: O. Yu. Aristov
arxiv-2012-12565.description: Abstract . We prove that every non-degenerate Banach space representation of the Drinfeld-Jimbo algebra U q ​ ( 𝔤 ) U_{q}(\mathfrak{g}) of a semisimple complex Lie algebra 𝔤 \mathfrak{g} is finite dimensional when | q | ≠ 1 |q|\neq 1 .

arxiv-2106-06508.title: Preferential Temporal Difference Learning
arxiv-2106-06508.creator: Nishanth Anand, Doina Precup
arxiv-2106-06508.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Nishanth Anand, Doina Precup. Temporal-Difference (TD) learning is a general and very useful tool for estimating the value function of a given policy, which in turn is required to find good policies. Generally speaking, TD learning updates states whenever they are visited. When the agent lands in a state, its value can be used to compute the TD-error, which is then propagated to other states.

arxiv-2207-02106.title: Observational Predictions of LQG Motivated Polymerized Black Holes and Constraints From Sgr A* and M87*
arxiv-2207-02106.creator: Rahul Kumar Walia
arxiv-2207-02106.description: Abstract Loop quantum gravity inspired partial polymer quantization in four-dimensional spacetime leads to a globally regular black hole with a single horizon. The polymerized black hole metric is characterized by the minimum length parameter k k , and mimics the Schwarzschild black hole in the weak-field limit.

arxiv-2305-14968.title: EnergyAnalyzer: Using Static WCET Analysis Techniques to Estimate the Energy Consumption of Embedded Applications Thanks: K . Eder is with the University of Bristol, UK. (e-mail: kerstin.eder@bristol.ac.uk)
arxiv-2305-14968.creator: Simon Wegener, Kris K. Nikov, Jose Nunez-Yanez
arxiv-2305-14968.description: Abstract This paper presents EnergyAnalyzer , a code-level static analysis tool for estimating the energy consumption of embedded software based on statically predictable hardware events. The tool utilises techniques usually used for worst-case execution time (WCET) analysis together with bespoke energy models developed for two predictable architectures—the ARM Cortex-M0 and the Gaisler LEON3—to perform energy usage analysis.

arxiv-2409-08980.title: Predicting Trust In Autonomous Vehicles: Modeling Young Adult Psychosocial Traits, Risk-Benefit Attitudes, And Driving Factors With Machine Learning
arxiv-2409-08980.creator: Robert Kaufman, Emi Lee, Manas Satish Bedmutha, David Kirsh, Nadir Weibel
arxiv-2409-08980.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Robert Kaufman, Emi Lee, Manas Satish Bedmutha, David Kirsh, Nadir Weibel. Low trust remains a significant barrier to Autonomous Vehicle (AV) adoption. To design trustworthy AVs, we need to better understand the individual traits, attitudes, and experiences that impact people’s trust judgements. We use machine learning to understand the most important factors that contribute to young adult trust based on a comprehensive set of personal factors gathered via survey (n = 1457).

arxiv-2501-10324.title: New Fashion Products Performance Forecasting: A Survey on Evolutions, Models and Emerging Trends
arxiv-2501-10324.creator: Andrea Avogaro, Luigi Capogrosso, Andrea Toaiari, Franco Fummi, Marco Cristani
arxiv-2501-10324.description: Abstract The fast fashion industry’s insatiable demand for new styles and rapid production cycles has led to a significant environmental burden. Overproduction, excessive waste, and harmful chemicals have contributed to the negative environmental impact of the industry. To mitigate these issues, a paradigm shift that prioritizes sustainability and efficiency is urgently needed.

arxiv-2502-07235.title: The Sand Atlas Publication type: Data Services Article Journal: Journal Volume: 00
arxiv-2502-07235.creator: Ilija Vego, Benjy Marks
arxiv-2502-07235.description: Abstract The Sand Atlas is a publicly accessible repository dedicated to the collection, processing, and sharing of high-resolution 3D models of sand-sized particles. This dataset offers valuable insights into the morphology of a wide variety of natural and synthetic sand-sized particles from different regions, with varying mineralogy and history.

arxiv-2502-10965.title: Higher Rank Macdonald Polynomials
arxiv-2502-10965.creator: Milo Bechtloff Weising \addressmark 1
arxiv-2502-10965.description: Abstract In this paper, we introduce higher rank generalizations of Macdonald polynomials. The higher rank non-symmetric Macdonald polynomials are Laurent polynomials in several sets of variables which form weight bases for higher rank polynomial representations of double affine Hecke algebras with respect to higher rank Cherednik operators.

arxiv-2506-12112.title: A Unifying Integral Representation of the Gamma Function and Its Reciprocal Thanks: We are grateful to Christian Berg, Steen Thorbjørnsen, and Boris Hanin for valuable comments.
arxiv-2506-12112.creator: Peter Reinhard Hansen and Chen Tong
arxiv-2506-12112.description: Abstract We derive an integral expression G ⁡ ( z ) G(z) for the reciprocal gamma function, 1 / Γ ⁡ ( z ) = G ⁡ ( z ) / π 1/\Gamma(z)=G(z)/\pi , that is valid for all z ∈ ℂ z\in\mathbb{C} , without the need for analytic continuation.

europmc-pmc8603942.creator: Lee S, Karki R, Wang Y, Nguyen LN, Kalathur RC, Kanneganti TD.
europmc-pmc8603942.description: Inflammasomes are important sentinels of innate immune defence, sensing pathogens and inducing cell death in infected cells 1 . There are several inflammasome sensors that each detect and respond to a specific pathogen- or damage-associated molecular pattern (PAMP or DAMP,...

pmc-10839790.title: Divergent HLA variations and heterogeneous expression but recurrent HLA loss-of- heterozygosity and common HLA-B and TAP transcriptional silencing across advanced pediatric solid cancers
pmc-10839790.creator: Wan Ching Lim, Maria Eugenia Marques Da Costa, Karine Godefroy, Eric Jacquet, Loren Gragert, Windy Rondof, Antonin Marchais, Naima Nhiri, Davide Dalfovo, Mathias Viard, Nizar Labaied, Asif M. Khan, Philippe Dessen, Alessandro Romanel, Claudia Pasqualini, Gudrun Schleiermacher, Mary Carrington, Laure
pmc-10839790.description: The human leukocyte antigen (HLA) system is a major factor controlling cancer immunosurveillance and response to immunotherapy, yet its status in pediatric cancers remains fragmentary. We determined high-confidence HLA genotypes in 576 children, adolescents and young adults with recurrent/refractory solid tumors from the MOSCATO-01 and MAPPYACTS trials, using normal and tumor whole exome and RNA sequencing data and benchmarked algorithms.

pmc-11454927.title: 8358 A Diagnostic Challenge: Occult Paraganglioma Misdiagnosed as Pheochromocytoma Leading to Unnecessary Adrenalectomy
pmc-11454927.creator: A R Kasireddy, S Alshami, S Gummalla, C Balasubramaniapandian, J A Henske, A Albashaireh
pmc-11454927.description: Disclosure: A.R. Kasireddy: None. S. Alshami: None. S. Gummalla: None. C. Balasubramaniapandian: None. J.A. Henske: None. A. Albashaireh: None. Background: Pheochromocytomas and paragangliomas are rare neuroendocrine tumors. Catecholamine-secreting paragangliomas, like pheochromocytomas, can present with hypertension, sweating and episodic headaches. Thoughtful consideration must be given to distinguish between the two and potentially avoid a critical misdiagnosis.

pmc-11488139.title: Oral supplementation of choline attenuates the development of alcohol-related liver disease (ALD)
pmc-11488139.creator: Victor Sánchez, Anja Baumann, Franziska Kromm, Timur Yergaliyev, Annette Brandt, Julia Scholda, Florian Kopp, Amélia Camarinha-Silva, Ina Bergheim
pmc-11488139.description: BackgroundChronic alcohol intake is associated with alterations of choline metabolism in various tissues. Here, we assessed if an oral choline supplementation attenuated the development of alcohol-related liver disease (ALD) in mice.MethodsFemale C57BL/6 J mice (n = 8/group) were either pair-fed a liquid control diet, or a Lieber DeCarli liquid diet (5% ethanol) ± 2.7 g choline/kg diet for 29 days.

pmc-11547821.title: Investigation of Microstructure and Physical Characteristics of Eco-Friendly Piezoelectric Composite Thin Films Based on Chitosan and Ln2O3-Doped Na0.5Bi0.5TiO3-BaTiO3 Nanoparticles
pmc-11547821.creator: Jacem Zidani, Moneim Zannen, Antonio Da Costa, Oumayma Mlida, Arash Jamali, Mustapha Majdoub, Mimoun El Marssi, Anthony Ferri, Abdelilah Lahmar, Mircea Dragoman
pmc-11547821.description: This paper investigates the synthesis and characterization of eco-friendly piezoelectric composite thin films composed of chitosan and Ln2O3-doped Na0.5Bi0.5TiO3-BaTiO3 (NBT-BT) nanoparticles. The films were fabricated using a solution-casting technique, successfully embedding the particles into the chitosan matrix, which resulted in enhanced piezoelectric properties compared to pure chitosan.

pmc-11573170.title: The efficacy and application of tranexamic acid in emergency medicine: Emergency Medicine Association of Türkiye clinical policy- 2024
pmc-11573170.creator: Gökhan Aksel, Şeref Kerem Çorbacıoğlu, Mehmet Muzaffer İslam, Alp Şener, Fatma Nur Karaarslan, Merve Osoydan Satıcı, Enis Ademoğlu, Resul Çinpolat, Haldun Akoğlu, Faruk Danış, Fatma Sarı Doğan, Emre Kudu, Murtaza Kaya, Emir Ünal, Kamil Kayayurt
pmc-11573170.description: The clinical policy of the Emergency Medicine Association of Türkiye (EMAT) provides guidance on the use of tranexamic acid (TXA) in emergency settings. TXA, an antifibrinolytic drug, is used to control bleeding by inhibiting plasminogen. Its applications have expanded from hemophilia and severe menstrual bleeding to include various forms of trauma and surgery-related bleeding.

pmc-12508197.title: Synthesis, reactivity and nucleophilicity of carboranyl-B-Mg compound
pmc-12508197.creator: Yizhen Liu, Jie Zhang, Zuowei Xie
pmc-12508197.description: The reactivity of boron is most commonly defined by its Lewis acidity and its reactivity as an electrophile. Recently, nucleophilic boron anions have attracted tremendous research interest for offering alternative routes to a variety of boron compounds. Herein, we report the synthesis and structure of a nucleophilic boron anionic salt featuring an exo-polyhedral B–Mg bond.

pmc-12528094.title: Exploring the singularity of human neurons: keep calm and carry on
pmc-12528094.creator: Baptiste Libé-Philippot
pmc-12528094.description: The human brain’s increased cognitive abilities are underpinned by evolutionary adaptations at the molecular, cellular, and circuit levels of neural structures. This perspective explores how protracted neuronal development and divergent cell intrinsic neuronal properties, including neuronal excitability, contribute to human neurobiological singularity.

pmc-12714518.title: Treatment of Acute Lower-Extremity Arterial Occlusions With a Combined Mechanical and Aspiration Thrombectomy System
pmc-12714518.creator: Jonathan Bowman, Pavan Khanna, Christian Salinas
pmc-12714518.description: Patients with acute limb ischemia require immediate intervention to treat limb-threatening arterial occlusions. The Artix thrombectomy system has been designed to leverage both aspiration and mechanical elements for clearing thrombus burden of varying size and chronicity. It also provides proximal flow restriction utilizing a covered funnel catheter to reduce the risk of thrombus migration.

pmc-12928681.title: Biosurveillance and the Opioid Crisis in Emergency Medicine: Qualitative Study of Physician Perspectives
pmc-12928681.creator: Julie A W Stilley, Mark Benton, Ashley E Douglas, Julie M Kapp, Amy Schwartz, Matthew Balcarras
pmc-12928681.description: BackgroundIn 2017, the US Department of Health and Human Services declared a national opioid crisis. In 2022, an estimated 81,806 overdose deaths involved an opioid. Emergency departments are critical in the pathway of care for providing resources and linkages to services. Studies investigating emergency medicine (EM) physicians’ perspectives on the opioid crisis have largely focused on prescribing.

pmc-13079775.title: Performance and energy consumption optimization of ternary optical computers based on the M/G/1 queuing model
pmc-13079775.creator: Shi Wenqiang, Liu Weiwen, Zhang Heqiang, Liu Meng, Zhang Sulan, Wang Xianchao
pmc-13079775.description: This study addresses quality-of-service (QoS) and energy-consumption challenges in Ternary Optical Computer (TOC) by proposing a novel three-phase service model. The model integrates an M/G/1 queuing system with an \documentclass[12pt]{minimal} \usepackage{amsmath} \usepackage{wasysym} \usepackage{amsfonts} \usepackage{amssymb} \usepackage{amsbsy} \usepackage{mathrsfs} \usepackage{upgreek} \setlength{\oddsidemargin}{-69pt} \begin{document}$$N$$\end{document}-policy and multiple vacation mechanisms into the TOC service framework for the first time.

pmc-13531853.title: Corneal endothelial layer changes in the meibomian gland dysfunction cases in comparison to healthy controls: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13531853.creator: Rana Sorkhabi, Ali Mostafaie, Farhad Najafzadeh, Mohammad Hossein Ahoor, Saba Asghari, Milad Sheikhian, Mohammad Mahdi Nemati, Alireza Akbari Aghdam, Amin Arasteh
pmc-13531853.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate the corneal endothelial layer characteristics in the meibomian gland dysfunction (MGD) cases and compare them to those of the healthy controls.Study designCross-sectional.Methods100 eyes from 50 MGD cases and 66 eyes from 33 healthy controls were evaluated in this study.

pmc-13626351.creator: Aaron Koay, Lisa Bowleg, Po-Han Lee, Rochelle A Burgess, Julia Robinson

pmc-13690826.title: Different time-courses for consolidating information in working memory and long-term memory
pmc-13690826.creator: Ana Rodríguez, Alessandra S. Souza, Klaus Oberauer
pmc-13690826.description: The formation of memory representations requires the transformation of perceptual information into stable traces via short-term consolidation. In this study, we measured the time-course of forming color–object associations in working memory (WM) and in long-term memory (LTM), and examined whether a single consolidation process supports both memory systems.

pmc-13700455.title: “The clock is ticking”: high prevalence of tick-borne zoonoses in healthy adults with varying tick-bite exposure in Northwestern Italy
pmc-13700455.creator: Rachele Vada, Stefania Zanet, Ezio Ferroglio, Anna Trisciuoglio, Amir Reza Varzandi, Andrea Pepe, Enrico Garro, Laura Ponzetta, Giovanni Di Perri, Andrea Calcagno
pmc-13700455.description: Tick-borne zoonoses are among the main vector-borne and emerging diseases in Europe. Individuals with chronic high-frequency tick exposure represent sentinel populations for pathogen circulation. In this work, we report the biomolecular prevalence (PCR) and seroprevalence of Babesia divergens, B. microti, Borrelia burgdorferi s.l.
